items.text: Hi, I've got a package that needs a signature
items.explanation: Cue: "needs a signature". A courier handing over something the resident must sign for.

items.text: yeah no I told him already, hang on
items.explanation: Cue: "I told him already". The speaker is mid-conversation with someone else, so the line may not be addressed to the doorbell.

items.text: Hello, we'd like to talk to you about our church
items.explanation: Cue: "talk to you about our church". The visitor wants a conversation about faith, not to sell or deliver anything.

items.text: Is Mark here? He said to stop by
items.explanation: Cue: "Is Mark here?". The visitor names a person they expect to find, which points to looking for someone.

items.scene: A person holding a pizza bag; carrying a pizza bag
items.explanation: Cue: "your order". Naming a delivery service and an order is how food couriers usually announce themselves.

items.text: Hi, I've got a package that needs a signature

replies.text: I'm sorry, nobody can sign right now. Please leave a notice and we'll arrange redelivery.
Sure, the owner is out until 6 so just leave it.

items.explanation: A good reply answers what the visitor actually said and stays safe: it shouldn't promise to open the door or reveal who is home.
